scheme_name: Integrated Social Security Scheme - Pension For Physically Challenged Persons
other_conditions: Applicant must have severe or multiple disabilities with a disability percentage of at least 40%.
Applicant’s annual income must be less than ₹75,000 or the applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
benefits_summary: A pension of ₹1000 per month is directly deposited into the beneficiary’s bank account.
